pokedexEntries.rb: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

pokedexEntries.ye: Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this POKéMON runs at high speed on developed legs.

pokedexEntries.go: By alternately raising and lowering its two heads, it balances itself to be more stable while running.

pokedexEntries.si: It races through grassy plains with powerful strides, leaving footprints up to four inches deep.

pokedexEntries.cr: It lives on a grassy plain where it can see a long way. If it sees an enemy, it runs away at 60 mph.

pokedexEntries.ru: DODUO’s two heads never sleep at the same time. Its two heads take turns sleeping, so one head can always keep watch for enemies while the other one sleeps.

pokedexEntries.sa: DODUO’s two heads contain completely identical brains. A scientific study reported that on rare occasions, there will be examples of this POKéMON possessing different sets of brains.

pokedexEntries.fr: A two-headed POKéMON that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.

pokedexEntries.lg: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

pokedexEntries.em: Even while eating or sleeping, one of the heads remains always vigilant for any sign of danger. When threatened, it flees at over 60 miles per hour.

pokedexEntries.dpp: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

pokedexEntries.y: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
